name: listen-button
title: Listen button
description: Listen to this article with the browser's own speech: play, pause and stop, a choice of speed, and the sentence being read highlighted.
docs: Pass text, or targetRef for an element whose text is read sentence by sentence (the sentence being read is highlighted with the CSS Custom Highlight API, without touching your markup; mark anything that should not be read with data-listen-skip). lang picks the voice and how sentences are cut. The button reads in sentences, which also avoids Chrome stopping long utterances, and stops when the page is hidden or unmounts. Progress is shown as sentences, not time. A page has one voice: pressing a second button stops the first, and if anything else cuts the speech off the button goes back to rest. Where the browser has no speech synthesis it renders nothing; pass engine to supply your own.
